items.title: We gave 22 LLMs a Myers-Briggs-style personality test
items.author: fairestvalue
items.snippet: The Open Extended Jungian Type Scales assigns a letter for each preference. Each logo below is a model’s average, from 8 on the left to 40 on the right. The center line is the cutoff. Introversion or Extraversion? Do you recharge on your own or around other people? I ·…
